reuse.why: Uses the existing shouldFillCategory and its already-defined 'include' HiddenPolicy from fill-categories.ts, and threads the flag through the existing getAverageCategories helper.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; only the small 'includeHiddenCategories ? include : <default>' mapping is repeated at three call points instead of being resolved once.

placement.why: The flag is handled at the action layer in budget/actions.ts while the selection rule stays in fill-categories.ts.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions' signatures, the averages helper and a release note.

maintainability.why: Straightforward and consistent; the repeated ternary keeps each action's default policy visible but means a new action must repeat it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions still decide through shouldFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the one-line policy ternary.
